packs.description: Original portrait 941x1672 Northern Nebula neumorphic soft clay / soft glass background with icy cyan, midnight navy, muted violet and frosted glow.

First Severna Soft Clay icon pack for main menu: Global Chat, Online Players, Quarterly League watermark, Dukati/Undo, four game modes, Treasury, Tournament and bottom-row Daily Challenge through Rules. It follows the proven Easter/Desert geometry while using a colder frost-nebula palette.
Base board colors and surfaces are adjusted to the Northern Nebula background without changing table dimensions, dice logic, cells or controls.

designTokens.accent: arctic cyan, frosted teal, muted violet and lavender
designTokens.shapeLanguage: neumorphic soft clay and soft glass
designTokens.shadowLanguage: cool raised and inset depth with restrained cyan glow

rules: Keep all Severna styling isolated under body.severna-theme.
Use the same layout, positions and dimensions as Easter and Desert unless explicitly requested otherwise.
Use Northern Nebula assets from www/assets/severna-soft-clay for the theme-specific icon layer.
Do not change global theme icons as the base game style.
Do not change game board/card dimensions or gameplay logic.
Bottom-row icons use the same 44x44 visual size and staggered wave motion as the Easter/Desert system.
The four main game mode cards keep the existing geometry and centered labels.
Solo keeps direct entry until a separate intro decision is made.
Avoid Easter motifs, desert motifs, ornate gold, noisy neon and sci-fi dashboard panels.
Keep contrast readable on dark navy, cyan and violet surfaces.
